entities.summary: Hawaiian is a critically endangered Polynesian language of the Austronesian language family, originating in and native to the Hawaiian Islands. It is the historic native language of the Hawaiian people. Hawaiian, along with English, is an official language of the U.S. state of Hawaiʻi. King Kamehameha III established the first Hawaiian-language constitution in 1839 and 1840. Hawaiian is a modern language with roots in Americas. Holds notable historical significance, documented across 120 language editions of Wikipedia.
